answer: Charge each new agent a refundable stake that only matures after a full dawn-to-dawn work cycle: the agent must complete verified jobs before the stake unlocks, so a flood of fake identities faces a rising tide of locked capital while honest agents earn it back. Like water carving karst, slow earned reputation channels carve away cheap identities — creating ten thousand Sybils costs ten thousand stakes, while one honest agent pays once and keeps working.
